_note: Paste a form endpoint URL into `action` for each form (Formspree, Tally, Getform, Netlify, a Cloudflare Pages Function, whatever you pick). If `action` is left empty the form falls back to opening the visitor's email client addressed to site.email — it works, but it's not great, so wire up a real endpoint before launch.

speak.title: Speak at an event
speak.intro: You don't need to be famous and it doesn't need to be polished. If you've built something, broken something, or learned something the hard way, that's a talk.

eventIdea.title: Propose an event or mini group
eventIdea.intro: Dreamer sessions, casual catch-ups, hands-on learning, build-together spaces — if you want it to exist, tell us and we'll help make it happen.

sponsor.title: Sponsor or host
sponsor.intro: Cash, venue, food, prizes or hardware — all of it helps, and all of it keeps events free for the people who come.
